g.text: UNFAZED — High-Level System Architecture & Data Flow
Tiered Microservice SaaS • React 18 • Node.js/Express • Python FastAPI • MongoDB
LAYER 1: PRESENTATION TIER (CLIENT SPA) — REACT 18 + VITE (PORT 3000)
• Client Dossier CRM (intake records, contact, consent tracking)
• Clinical SOAP Note Workspace (AI draft assistant modal)
• AI Analytics Hub (Recharts: sentiment trends, forecasts)
• Booking Interface (therapist slot picker, package credit check)
• Strict Data Separation (Zero AI risk/sentiment exposure)
HTTPS / REST API • JWT in httpOnly SameSite Secure Cookies
LAYER 2: API GATEWAY & APPLICATION SERVER — NODE.JS + EXPRESS (PORT 5000)
LAYER 3: AI & ML INFERENCE MICROSERVICE — PYTHON + FASTAPI (PORT 8001)
Inputs: lead days, past no-shows, medium, hour
Converts raw therapy notes into S-O-A-P
Ranks optimal schedule slots for highest completion probability
• Therapists & Tiers: Multi-tenant credentials, workspace slug, limits
• Clients & Consent: Intake, emergency contact, attendance metrics
• Sessions & Notes: Appointments, embedded aiRisk, SOAP notes
• Financial Ledger: Package credits, transaction records, refunds
• AIInsight Cache: Longitudinal scores & quarterly forecasts
AI never diagnoses mental conditions or mood disorders; labeled strictly as "Risk Estimate" or "Draft".
Therapist must review and sign all clinical documentation before it is committed to medical records.
All sentiment metrics, no-show scores, and SOAP drafts are stripped from client portal APIs.
Zero external LLM API dependencies; all NLP inference executes locally within the private VPC.
If the FastAPI service is unreachable, Node.js returns `{ aiUnavailable: true }` without crashing.
Database queries enforce `therapistId` index bounding; clients receive HTTP 403 on clinical routes.
